title: Kausal IDHS: design-based causal graph discovery and confounder selection for complex survey data
description: Configuration-driven Python pipeline (code and locked analysis plan) for the study 'Survey-design-calibrated independence tests reduce adjustment-set validity in PC-based causal discovery'. It implements design-corrected conditional-independence tests (Rao-Scott, design t test), PC-stable with temporal tiers, seven confounder-selection strategies, cross-fitted AIPW with design-based standard errors, and a simulation benchmark mimicking the 2017 Indonesia Demographic and Health Survey. IDHS microdata are not included and must be requested from The DHS Program. Release v1.1 added the deviation log (CATATAN_DEVIASI.md) and the verification scripts and reports in verifikasi/. Release v1.2 adds the exploratory strategy M7 (optimal adjustment set estimated from the M3 graph): bench_v4_m7.py and its per-replication output naskah/data/benchmark_v4/per_rep_m7.csv (4,800 replications; data and graphs identical to M0-M6), documented as a deviation in CATATAN_DEVIASI.md section 7.
